data.action: 坐于营地木箱双手捧热咖啡杯，火光映照柔和微笑
data.animaCaption: Seated on a wooden crate beside a crackling campfire beneath a starry canyon sky, she wraps both gloved hands around a warm tin mug and offers a rare, gentle smile.
data.description: 群星璀璨的荒原峡谷营地里，跃动的篝火驱散夜寒，嘉贝莉娜披着靛蓝几何纹羊毛斗篷坐在木箱上，手捧搪瓷咖啡杯难得露出柔和笑意。
data.lighting: 篝火暖橙跃动火光与深蓝银河夜空对比
data.location: 荒原峡谷星空篝火营地
data.promptProse: Beside a crackling campfire in a quiet rocky canyon under the Milky Way, Galbrena wears a heavy charcoal-and-indigo woven poncho and holds a steaming tin mug with a softened, genuine smile.
data.title: 嘉贝莉娜 · 荒原篝火旁披靛蓝羊毛斗篷煮咖啡
